3528.objective: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

3701.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
3701.objective: Venture to the Ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes and recover information from the Thaurissan Relics. Return to Royal Historian Archesonus when you have recovered the information.

3702.name: The Smoldering Ruins of Thaurissan
3702.objective: Listen to Royal Historian Archesonus recant the history of Thaurissan.

3801.name: Dark Iron Legacy
3801.objective: Speak with Franclorn Forgewright if you are interested in obtaining a key to the city major.

3906.name: Disharmony of Flame
3906.objective: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.

3981.name: Commander Gor'shak
3981.objective: Find Commander Gor'shak in Blackrock Depths. You recall that the crudely drawn picture of the orc included bars drawn over the portrait. Perhaps you should search for a prison of some sort.

4001.name: What Is Going On?
4001.objective: Speak with Kharan Mighthammer and gather information about Princess Moira Bronzebeard's kidnapping. Take that information to Thrall in Orgrimmar. You recall Gor'shak mentioning that Kharan is being held in a cell nearby.

4002.name: The Eastern Kingdom
4002.objective: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.

4003.name: The Royal Rescue
4003.objective: Slay Emperor Dagran Thaurissan and free Princess Moira Bronzebeard from his evil spell.

4022.name: A Taste of Flame
4022.objective: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.

4023.name: A Taste of Flame
4023.objective: Show Cyrus Therepentous proof of your worth. You have a feeling that Cyrus already knows that you are unworthy.

4061.name: The Rise of the Machines
4061.objective: Venture to the Burning Steppes and recover 10 Fractured Elemental Shards for Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania. You recall Theodora mentioning the golems and elementals of that region as being a source for these shards.

4062.name: The Rise of the Machines
4062.objective: Take the Elemental Shard Sample to Lotwil Veriatus. You recall Theodora saying that Lotwil was stationed in a camp to the east.

4081.name: KILL ON SIGHT: Dark Iron Dwarves
4081.objective: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 15 Anvilrage Guardsmen, 10 Anvilrage Wardens and 5 Anvilrage Footmen. Return to him once your task is complete.

4082.name: KILL ON SIGHT: High Ranking Dark Iron Officials
4082.objective: Venture to Blackrock Depths and destroy the vile aggressors! Warlord Goretooth wants you to kill 10 Anvilrage Medics, 10 Anvilrage Soldiers and 10 Anvilrage Officers. Return to him once your task is complete.

4121.name: Precarious Predicament
4121.objective: Escort your prisoner, Grark Lorkrub, through Burning Steppes and through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he would have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody. You will also be required to hand over your Thorium Shackles to Lexlort.

4122.name: Grark Lorkrub
4122.objective: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress. When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.

4141.name: Muigin and Larion
4141.objective: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.

4142.name: A Visit to Gregan
4142.objective: Take a Bloodpetal to Gregan Brewspewer in Feralas.

4145.name: Larion and Muigin
4145.objective: Hunt 5 Bloodpetal Lashers, 5 Bloodpetal Threshers, 5 Bloodpetal Flayers and 5 Bloodpetal Trappers for Larion at Marshal's Refuge.

4147.name: Marvon's Workshop
4147.objective: Travel to Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

4182.name: Dragonkin Menace
4182.objective: Slay 15 Black Broodlings, 10 Black Dragonspawn, 4 Black Wyrmkin and 1 Black Drake. Return to Helendis Riverhorn when the task is complete.

4183.name: The True Masters
4183.objective: Travel to Lakeshire and deliver Helendis Riverhorn's Letter to Magistrate Solomon.

4184.name: The True Masters
4184.objective: Travel to Stormwind and deliver Solomon's Plea to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. Bolvar resides in Stormwind Keep.

4185.name: The True Masters
4185.objective: Speak with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon after speaking with Lady Katrana Prestor.

4186.name: The True Masters
4186.objective: Take Bolvar's Decree to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.

4223.name: The True Masters
4223.objective: Speak with Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes.

4224.name: The True Masters
4224.objective: Speak with Ragged John to learn of Marshal Windsor's fate and return to Marshal Maxwell when you have completed this task. You recall Marshal Maxwell telling you to search for him in a cave to the north.

4241.name: Marshal Windsor
4241.objective: Travel to Blackrock Mountain in the northwest and enter Blackrock Depths. Find out what became of Marshal Windsor. You recall Ragged John talking about Windsor being dragged off to a prison.

4242.name: Abandoned Hope
4242.objective: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.

4262.name: Overmaster Pyron
4262.objective: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig. You recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?

4264.name: A Crumpled Up Note
4264.objective: You may have just stumbled on to something that Marshal Windsor would be interested in seeing. There may be hope, after all.

4282.name: A Shred of Hope
4282.objective: Return Marshal Windsor's Lost Information. Marshal Windsor believes that the information is being held by Golem Lord Argelmach and General Angerforge.

4322.name: Jail Break!
4322.objective: Help Marshal Windsor get his gear back and free his friends. Return to Marshal Maxwell if you succeed.

4341.name: Kharan Mighthammer
4341.objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and find Kharan Mighthammer. The King mentioned that Kharan was being held prisoner there - perhaps you should try looking for a prison.

4342.name: Kharan's Tale
4342.objective: Listen as Kharan Mighthammer tells his story.

4361.name: The Bearer of Bad News
4361.objective: Return to Ironforge and deliver the bad news to King Magni Bronzebeard.

4362.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
4362.objective: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.

4601.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
4601.objective: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

4602.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
4602.objective: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.

4726.name: Broodling Essence
4726.objective: Bring 8 Broodling Essence and the Draco-Incarcinatrix 900 to Tinkee Steamboil at the Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

4734.name: Egg Freezing
4734.objective: Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.

4735.name: Egg Collection
4735.objective: Bring 8 Collected Dragon Eggs and the Collectronic Module to Tinkee Steamboil at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes.

4742.name: Seal of Ascension
4742.objective: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan. The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.

4764.name: Doomrigger's Clasp
4764.objective: Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

4787.name: The Ancient Egg
4787.objective: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

4788.name: The Final Tablets
4788.objective: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

4808.name: Felnok Steelspring
4808.objective: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

4809.name: Chillwind Horns
4809.objective: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

4810.name: Return to Tinkee
4810.objective: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

4903.name: Warlord's Command
4903.objective: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

4941.name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
4941.objective: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall. You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

4974.name: For The Horde!
4974.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

4981.name: Operative Bijou
4981.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

4982.name: Bijou's Belongings
4982.objective: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

5001.name: Bijou's Belongings
5001.objective: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!

5002.name: Message to Maxwell
5002.objective: Travel to the Burning Steppes and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.

5065.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
5065.objective: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

5089.name: General Drakkisath's Command
5089.objective: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.

5103.name: Hot Fiery Death
5103.objective: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!

5126.name: Lorax's Tale
5126.objective: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

5160.name: The Matron Protectorate
5160.objective: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

5161.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
5161.objective: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

5162.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
5162.objective: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

5164.name: Catalogue of the Wayward
5164.objective: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

5212.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
5212.objective: Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

5251.name: The Archivist
5251.objective: Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.

5262.name: The Truth Comes Crashing Down
5262.objective: Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.

5281.name: The Restless Souls
5281.objective: Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

5382.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
5382.objective: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

5384.name: Kirtonos the Herald
5384.objective: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul. Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

5461.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
5461.objective: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

5462.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
5462.objective: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

5463.name: Menethil's Gift
5463.objective: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.

5464.name: Menethil's Gift
5464.objective: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

5465.name: Soulbound Keepsake
5465.objective: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

5515.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
5515.objective: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

5518.name: The Gordok Ogre Suit
5518.objective: Bring 4 Bolts of Runecloth, 8 Rugged Leather, 2 Rune Threads, and Ogre Tannin to Knot Thimblejack. He is currently chained inside the Gordok wing of Dire Maul.

5522.name: Leonid Barthalomew
5522.objective: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

5529.name: Plagued Hatchlings
5529.objective: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

5531.name: Betina Bigglezink
5531.objective: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

5542.name: Demon Dogs
5542.objective: Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.

5543.name: Blood Tinged Skies
5543.objective: Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.

5544.name: Carrion Grubbage
5544.objective: Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.

5722.name: Searching for the Lost Satchel
5722.objective: Search Ragefire Chasm for Maur Grimtotem's corpse and search it for any items of interest.

5726.name: Hidden Enemies
5726.objective: Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5727.name: Hidden Enemies
5727.objective: Take the Lieutenant's Insignia to Neeru Fireblade and speak to him. Gauge if he believes you are a member of the Burning Blade and then return to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

5742.name: Redemption
5742.objective: Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

5781.name: Of Forgotten Memories
5781.objective: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

5845.name: Of Lost Honor
5845.objective: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.

5846.name: Of Love and Family
5846.objective: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.

6022.name: To Kill With Purpose
6022.objective: Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.

6042.name: Un-Life's Little Annoyances
6042.objective: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

6133.name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
6133.objective: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge. You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

6135.name: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
6135.objective: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller. It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.

6136.name: The Corpulent One
6136.objective: Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.

6402.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
6402.objective: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.

6403.name: The Great Masquerade
6403.objective: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

6501.name: The Dragon's Eye
6501.objective: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

6522.name: An Unholy Alliance
6522.objective: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6562.name: Trouble in the Deeps
6562.objective: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6564.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
6564.objective: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6567.name: The Champion of the Horde
6567.objective: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.

6568.name: The Testament of Rexxar
6568.objective: Deliver Rexxar's Letter to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

6569.name: Oculus Illusions
6569.objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

6570.name: Emberstrife
6570.objective: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

6582.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
6582.objective: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife. You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.

6583.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
6583.objective: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.

6584.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
6584.objective: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.

6585.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
6585.objective: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

6601.name: Ascension...
6601.objective: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

6627.name: Test of Lore
6627.objective: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

6804.name: Poisoned Water
6804.objective: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands. Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6805.name: Stormers and Rumblers
6805.objective: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6821.name: Eye of the Emberseer
6821.objective: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6822.name: The Molten Core
6822.objective: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6823.name: Agent of Hydraxis
6823.objective: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

7044.name: Legends of Maraudon
7044.objective: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond. Find a way to speak with Celebras.

7461.name: The Madness Within
7461.objective: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated. Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum. Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.

7481.name: Elven Legends
7481.objective: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.

7482.name: Elven Legends
7482.objective: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.

7507.name: Nostro's Compendium
7507.objective: Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.

7508.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
7508.objective: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.

start.name: A Dull and Flat Elven Blade

7632.name: The Ancient Leaf
7632.objective: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, <Name>; It's a big world.

7637.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
7637.objective: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer. You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.

7638.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
7638.objective: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

7639.name: To Show Due Judgment
7639.objective: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7640.name: Exorcising Terrordale
7640.objective: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale. When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7641.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
7641.objective: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

7785.name: Examine the Vessel
7785.objective: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian.

8153.name: Courser Antlers
8153.objective: Bring a pair of Perfect Courser Antlers to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath.

8231.name: Wavethrashing
8231.objective: Bring 6 Wavethrasher Scales to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.

8234.name: Sealed Azure Bag
8234.objective: Retrieve the Sealed Azure Bag from the Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara. Then take the bag to Archmage Xylem, also found in Azshara.

8235.name: Encoded Fragments
8235.objective: Bring 10 Encoded Fragments to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.

8251.name: Magic Dust
8251.objective: Bring 10 Glittering Dust to Archmage Xylem.

8252.name: The Siren's Coral
8252.objective: Collect 6 Enchanted Coral and return them to Archmage Xylem.

8255.name: Of Coursers We Know
8255.objective: Acquire 4 Healthy Courser Glands and bring them to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.

8256.name: The Ichor of Undeath
8256.objective: Acquire an Ichor of Undeath for Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.

8286.name: What Tomorrow Brings
8286.objective: Venture to the Caverns of Time in Tanaris and find Anachronos, Brood of Nozdormu.

8288.name: Only One May Rise
8288.objective: Return the Head of the Broodlord Lashlayer to Baristolth of the Shifting Sands at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

8301.name: The Path of the Righteous
8301.objective: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.

8303.name: Anachronos
8303.objective: Seek out Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

8305.name: Long Forgotten Memories
8305.objective: Locate the Crystalline Tear in Silithus and gaze into its depths.

8410.name: Elemental Mastery
8410.objective: Collect a sample of air, fire, earth and water for Bath'rah the Windwatcher.

8411.name: Mastering the Elements
8411.objective: Bring the elements earth, air, fire and water to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.

8412.name: Spirit Totem
8412.objective: Bring the pieces for the spirit totem to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.

8414.name: Dispelling Evil
8414.objective: Collect 20 Minion's Scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis in the Western Plaguelands.

8416.name: Inert Scourgestones
8416.objective: Bring the Inert Scourgestone to Commander Ashlan Valorfist in Chillwind Point.

8419.name: An Imp's Request
8419.objective: Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in Felwood.

8420.name: Hot and Itchy
8420.objective: Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in Felwood.

8421.name: The Wrong Stuff
8421.objective: Bring 10 Rotting Wood and 4 Bloodvenom Essence to Impsy in Felwood.

8423.name: Warrior Kinship
8423.objective: Kill 7 Helboar in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

8424.name: War on the Shadowsworn
8424.objective: Slaughter the Shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.

8519.name: A Pawn on the Eternal Board
8519.objective: Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris.

targets.name: The War of the Shifting Sands

8575.name: Azuregos's Magical Ledger
8575.objective: Deliver Azuregos's Magical Ledger to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

8577.name: Stewvul, Ex-B.F.F.
8577.objective: Narain Soothfancy wants you to find his ex-best friend forever (BFF), Stewvul, and take back the scrying goggles that Stewvul stole from him.

8578.name: Scrying Goggles? No Problem!
8578.objective: Find Narain's Scrying Goggles and return them to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

8584.name: Never Ask Me About My Business
8584.objective: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to speak with Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan.

8585.name: The Isle of Dread!
8585.objective: Recover Lakmaeran's Carcass and 20 Chimaerok Tenderloins for Dirge Quikcleave in Tanaris.

8586.name: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops
8586.objective: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.

8587.name: Return to Narain
8587.objective: Deliver the 500 Pound Chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

8597.name: Draconic for Dummies
